verdict.rationale: Parsec is a SaaS remote-desktop product with public docs and a Teams API, so publishing llms.txt or agent-oriented docs is a fair question and the axis applies. Probes found no such resources: parsec.app/llms.txt, the markdown version of the Teams API docs, and every candidate OpenAPI path returned HTTP 404. No vendor material claims agent-oriented documentation either.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
